[[Giygas]] crafts [[prestige armor]] for [[core]] and [[Factions]] [[profession]]s using the [[Kurzick armor#Elite|Elite Kurzick armor]] art. Giygas also crafts [[Elementalist headgear#Auras|Elementalist auras]]. All armor is crafted with an empty [[insignia slot]].

Elite Kurzick armor requires the [[rare crafting material]] [[Amber]].

==Locations==
*[[Echovald Forest]]
**{{NPC location|Vasburg Armory}}, in the northeast corner
